a: उकानहः — A horse of a red and yellow (or red and black) colour, a bay or chesnut horse.

a: उकारः — 1 The vowel उ. --2 The god Śiva.

m: उक्थामद n. praise and rejoicing, AV. v, 26, 3; AitBr.; Kāṭh.; TĀr.; MaitrS.
उक्थार्क n. recitation and hymn, RV. vi, 34, 1.
उक्था-वी mfn. fond of verses, VS.

s: klI, (vac + Tak .) sAmavedaH । ityuRAdikozaH ॥ (yaTA, fgvede । 3 । 64 । 7 । “viprA ukTeBiH kavayo gfRanti” ॥ stotram । yaTA, “aTa yosAvantarakziRi puruzo dfSyate sEvarka tatsAma tadyajuH tat ukTaM tadbrahya” । iti CAndogye upanizadi ॥)
v: na॰ vaca--Tak । apragItamantrasADye “strotre “indrAya nana marmayokTAni ca bravIta naH” F॰ 1, 84, 5 । “ukTAniM apragItamantrasADyAni strItrARi” BA॰ “aTa yo'sAvantarakziRiM puruzo dfSyate sEvark tat sAma tadyajuHtadukTaM tadbrahma” CA॰ u॰ । taTA hi stotraM dviviDaM pragItamantrasADyaBapragItamantrasADyaYca tatra pragItamantrasADyaM Sastram apragItamantrasADyantu stotramiti tayorBedaH । gavAmayane prAyaRIyasaMjYakAhe pAWyapaYcadaSastotrAtmake 2 caturviMSastomaBede upacArAt 3 tatsADye ukTyayAge ca tadviDAnaYca” tA॰ brA॰ 4 a॰ 3 Ka॰ uktaM yaTA “1 prAyaRIyamaharBavati” 1 ityupakramya “caturviMSaM Bavati” 4 ka॰ “idamaharukTasaMsTantatra sarvezu stotrezu caturviMSaeva stomaH kAryyaH 4 । tadetat praSaMsati” BA॰ । “caturviMSatyakzarA gAyatrI tejobrahmavarcasaNgAyatrI teja eva brahmavarcasamAraBya svaryanti” 5 । “ayaYca stomaScaturviMSatisaMKyAkaH gAyatrI ca caturviMSatyakzarA sA ca gAyatrI tejaH, prajApatimuKAdagninA sahotpannatvAt asyAstejIrUpaM brahmavarcasaM ca tejo'vAntaraBeda iti tejobrahmavarcasarUpA gAyatrI । evaM sati caturviMSatistomaM praTamataH prayuYjAnAH sAkzAdeva pratyakzameva saMvatsaraM prAraBante asminnahani prayuYjAnAH saMKyAdvAreRa tejobrahmavarcasaYcAraBya avazwaBya svaryyanti svargaM gacCanti 5 । punarapi vihitaM stomam anUdya praSaMsati” BA॰ । “caturviMSatirBavati catuviMSo vE saMvatsaraH sAkzAdeva saMvatsaramAraBante” 6 । “caturviMSatyardDamAsAtmakatvAt saMvatsarasya caturviM SatvaM taTA sati caturviMSastomaM praTamataH prayuYjAnAH sAkzAdeva pratyakzameva saMvatsaramAraBante 6 । aTemaM stomaM stotrIyAgatasaMKyAdvAreRa praSaMsati” BA॰ । “yAvatyaScaturviSasyokTasya stItrIyAstAvatyaH saMvatsarasya rAtrayaH stotrIyABireva saMvatsaramApruvanti” 7 । “paYcadaSastotre asminnahani paYcadaSasu stotrezu pratyekaM caturviMSastotrIyAyuktezu parigaRanAyAM militvA zazwyuttaratriSatastotrIyA Bavanti । taTA sati caturviMSastomasya yAvatyaH stotrIyAH saMvatrasyApi tAvatyorAtrayaH eva” prayuYjAnAH satriRastena caturviMSena stotrIyABireva saMvatsaraM prApnuvanti 7 । stotrasaMKyayApIdamahaH paSaMsati” BA॰ । “paYcadaSa stotrARi Bavanti paYcadaSArdDamAsasya rAtrayo'rdDamAsaSa eva tatsaMvatsaramApnuvanti 8 । “spazworTaH 8” । aTa stotraSastrARi samuccitya tatsaMKyayApIdamahaH praSaMsati” BA॰ “paYcadaSa stotrARi paYcadaSa SastrARi samAso mAsaSa eva nat saMvatsaramApnuvanti 9” spazwo'rTaH 9 BA॰ । tatrAgnizwomakarttavyatArUpaM pUrvapakzamupanyasyottarapakzamAha “aTo KalvAhurukTameva kAryyamahnaH samfdDyE” 13 । “aTo iti pUrvapakzavyAvfttyarTaH । ukTasaMsTamevEdahaH kAryyaH kimarTamahnaH samfdDyE sampUrRatAyA iti brahmavAdina AhuH । agnizwome hi pUrvayoH savanayoH paYca paYca stotrARi tftIye tu dve evetyahraH samfdDirna Bavati, ukTe tu tftIyasavane paYca stotrARItyahaH samfdDaM Bavati 13 । ukTasaMsTANgIkAre yuktyantaramAha” BA॰ । “sarvvARi rUpARi kriyante sarvvaM hyetenApyate” 14 “uttarezAmahnAM sambanDIni yAni rUpARi stomapfzWaviBaktyAdIni tAnyasminnukTe kriyante ataH sarvaM hi yajYasambanDirUpaM tenAhnA ukTasaMsTena Apyate prApyate tata ukTasaMsTEva kAryyetyarTaH । sarvarUpakaraRaYca sarvvAvAptiSca sampAdAnadvAreReti nidAnakAreREvamucyate, “aTo KalvAhuH sarvvARi rUpARi kriyanta iti” AcAryyAH etezveva sarvvAn stomAn sarvARi pfzWAni sarvA viBaktIrdaSarAtrarUpA iti viBaktimAtreRa kalpayanta iti saMgfhyoktvA punastrivftpaYcadaSO caturviMSaH sampAdyata ityAdinA” 14 BA॰ । etAnyeva stomapfzWAdIni pratyekaM krameRa vivicya tatra pradarSitAni tatsarvaM tata evAgantavyam । tatra ca tasminnahani yaTA stomAdikaM viDeyam tadapi tatrEva darSitaM tataeva tadavaseyam । atra ukTasADyayAge aBedopacAra iti boDyam । 4 hotrAyAM strI ukTASastraSabde udA॰ ucyate'nena karaRe Tak । 5 ukTasADane prARe ca “yasya kzaRaviyogena loko'hyapriyadarSanaH । ukTena rahitohyeza mftakaH procyate yaTA” BAga॰ 1 ska॰ 15 a॰ ।
m: उक्थ अम्, n. a saying, sentence, verse, eulogy, praise, RV.; AV.; VS.

(in the ritual) a kind of recitation or certain recited verses forming a subdivision of the Śastras (they generally form a series, and are recited in contradistinction to the Sāman verses which are sung and to the Yajus or muttered sacrificial formulas), AitBr.; TS.; ŚBr.; ChUp. &c.
(the महद्-उक्थम् or बृहद्-उक्थम्, ‘great Uktha’, forms a series of verses, in three sections, each containing eighty Tṛcas or triple verses, recited at the end of the Agnicayana)
N. of the Sāma-veda, ŚBr.
उक्थ m. a form of Agni, MBh.
N. of a prince, VP.
N. of a divine being belonging to the Viśve Devās, Hariv. 11542.
a: उक्थं — [वच्-थक्] 1 A saying, sentence, verse, hymn (स्तोत्रं). --2 Eulogy, praise. --3 N. of the Sāmaveda (Trik.); a variety of Sāma; (सामभेदः सामविशेषः). --4 (In ritual) A kind of recitation or certain recited verses (opp. सामन् chanted, and यजुस् muttered verses). --5 The उक्थ sacrifice. --क्था N. of a metre, see Appendix --Comp. --पत्रः {1} a sacrifice (having verses as its vehicle or leaves). {2} a sacrificer (यजमान). --पात्रं {1} a sacrificer. {2} vessels or libations offered during the recitation of an उक्थ. --भृत् m. a sage who offers or divides Ukthas. --वर्द्धन a. to be magnified or celebrated in praise, an epithet of Indra. --वाहस् a. offering verses; or one to whom verses are offered. --शंसिन् a. praising, uttering the Ukthas. (--m.) a kind of priest. --शस्, --शास्, शस a. Ved. uttering a verse, praising. --शुष्म a. whose strength is praise. {2} loudly resonant with verses. (--क्था) -वी a. fond of or reciting verses.

v: pu॰ ukTaM biBartti, samyakviBajate Bf--kvip 6 ta॰ । ukTaviBAjake fziBede “ukTaBftaM sAmaBftaM biBartti grIvARam” f॰ 7, 33, 14 । ukTaBftaM ukTAnAM stotrARAM saMBaktAram” ।
m: उक्थ—भृत् mfn. offering verses, RV. vii, 33, 14.
उक्थ—˚ं-वाच् f. a particular part of a Śastra, ĀśvŚr.

m: उक्थ—शास्त्र n. N. of wk.

m: उक्थ—शंसिन् mfn. praising, RV. vi, 45, 6; viii, 103, 4

m: उक्थ—शस् (in strong cases ˚शास्), mfn. and उक्थ—शस, mfn. uttering a verse, praising, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 71; RV.; AitBr.; TS.; KātyŚr.; ŚBr. &c.

v: tri॰ ukTaM SastraM SuzmaM balaM yasya । ukTarUpabalayukte stavAdivAkye “samudraM na sinDava ukTaSuzmA uruvyacasam” f॰ 6, 36, 3 । “ukTaSuzmAn vfzaBarAntsvapnasastAM” f॰ 10, 63, 3 ।
m: उक्थ—शुष्म (उक्थ˚), mfn. loudly resonant with verses, moving on with the sound of verses (as with the roaring of waters), accompanied by sounding verses
one whose strength is praise [Sāy.], RV.
उक्थ—दोह m. a particular final part of a Śastra, AitĀr.
उक्थ—मुख n. the beginning of an Uktha recitation, AitBr.; AitĀr.; ŚāṅkhBr.
उक्थ—पात्र n. vessels of libation offered during the recitation of an Uktha, Nir.

v: pu॰ ukTAni apragItamantrasADyAni stotrARi patraM vAhanamiva yasya । 1 yajYe, stotrEreva hi yajYovAhyate iti tasya taTAtvam । “samidDe agnAvaDimAmahAna ukTapatra IqyogfBItaH” yaju॰ 17, 55 । “yajamAnovE mAma hAna ukTapatra ityukTAni hyetasya patrARi” Sata॰ brA॰ 9, 2, 3, 9 ityukte 2 yajamAne'pi ।

m: उक्थ—पत्त्र mfn. having verses as wings, VS. xvii, 55.
उक्थ—संपद् f. a particular concluding verse of a Śastra, AitĀr.

v: pu॰ ukTAni SastrARi vahati vaha--asun Ricca । SastrapAWake vipre “yaM viprA ukTavAhaso'BipramaM durAyavaH” f॰ 8, 12, 13, । ukTavAhasaH ukTAnAM SastrARAM voQAraH” BA॰ ।

one to whom verses are offered, RV.
उक्थ—वीर्य n. a particular part of a Śastra, AitĀr.
उक्थ—वर्धन mfn. having hymns as a cause of refreshment, one who is refreshed or delighted by praise, RV. viii, 14, 11.

उक्थ—विद् mfn. conversant with, hymns of praise, ŚBr.

v: pu॰ ukTaM stutyatayA'styasya ukTa + ini । 1 SastrastAvake hotrAdO । “pra vAmarccantyukTino nITAvidojaritAraH” f॰ 3, 12, 5, “ukTaM SastraM tadvantaH SastriRo hotrAdayaH” BA॰ । “tadadyAcitta ukTino'nuzwuvanti pUrvvaTA” f॰ 8, 15, 6 । ukTaM stotrasADanatayA'styasya ini । 2 Sastrastutye indrAdO । “hiraRyaparRRamukTinaM raSanAM biBrataM vaSiM BagamindraM vayoDasam” yaju॰ 28, 33 ukTaM SastraM saMskArANgasADanatayA'styasva ini । 3 SastrasADye saMskArayukte somAdO । “tuByedindra! marutvate sutAH somAso adrivaH hfdA hUyanta ukTinaH” f॰ 8, 76, 8 । “ukTino'nyA hotrA ukTinaHSastravantaH somAH anukTA anyAH” Eta॰ ।

accompanied by praise or (in ritual) by Ukthas, RV.; VS.; AitBr.
a: उक्थिन् — a. [उक्थ-इनि] 1 Uttering verses, praising. --2 Accompanied by praise or Ukthas. --m. Indra and others.

v: tri॰ ukTamarhati yat । Sastrastutye devAdO । “indraH sahastradAvnAM varuRaH SaMsyAnAM kraturBavatyukTyaH” f॰ 1, 17, 5 । “ukuTyaH stutyaH” BA॰ “hotA gfRIta ukTyaH” f॰ 1, 79, 12 । 2 ukTasADane Sastre ca । “gAya gAyatramukTyam” f॰ 1, 38, 14 । ukTyaM SastrayogyaM gAyatramukTyam” BA॰ । ukTasambanDitvAt 3 Sastre 'pi । “ukTyaM vAci GozAya tveti SastvA japet” ASva॰ SrO॰ 5, 9, 26 । “ukTyaM SastraM SastrasambanDitayA” nArA॰ vfttiH । “somayAgAt paraM karttavyezu zawsu yAgezu maDye 4 yajYaBede sa ca । “praTamaM sopA” ityupakramya “zaquttare” “atyagnizwoma ukTyaH zoqaSI vAjapeyo'tirAtro'ptoryAmaH kAtyA॰ 10, 9, 27, 28 vihitaH । tatprakArastu tatrEva darSitaH prAk । tasya ukTasADyatvAt ukTyamiti nAma । “ukTe tu hotrakARAm” 1 । “tftIyasavanEvyanuvarttate । ukTe tvayaM viSezaH । tftIyasavane hotrakARAmapi SastrARi BaveyuH । tAnImAnItyAha” vfttiH । “ehyuzu bruvARi taAgniragAmi BArataScarzaRIDftamastaBrAdyAmasura iti tfcAvindrAvaruRA yuvamAvAM rAjAnAvindrAvaruRA maDumattamasyeti yAjyA । vayamu tvAmapUrvvayo na idamidaM pureti pragATO । sarvAH kakuBaH pramaMhizWAyodapruto'cCAma indraM vfhaspate yuvamindraSca vasva iti yAjyA । aGAhIndra girvaRa iyanta indra girvaRa kraturjanitrInU martto BavAmitraH sa vAM karmaRendrAvizRU madapatI madAnAmiti yAjyA” 2 । “atra sarvAH kakuBa ityuktaM kimanenoktam । kAkuBezu tAvat pragATezu tftIyapaYcamayoraByAse sati kakuBa eva sarvA Bavanti । taTEva ca stuvanti CandogAH । ato'nyat prayojanamanvezaRIyam । tadidamucyate । hotrakASca yezAM pragATAH stotrIyAnurUpA itIndranihavabrAhmaRaspatyavacCaMsanaM vihitam । tatra vArhatAnAmevAyaM viDirityuktatvAt kAkuBezvanuprApnoti tannivfttyarTaM kakuBa iti vacanam । savagrahaRaM sarvakAkuBapragATasaMgrahArTam । tena vArhatezvevAsO viDiriti mantavyam । “ityanta ukTyaH” 3 । “evamanta ukTyaH kraturityarTaH । ityanto'gnizwoma ityasyAnantaram etAni SastrARyukTyaH ityante ukTya ityetAvatyucyamAne etAni SastrARyukTya eveti gamyate । tat kimarTamukTe tu hotrakARAmityatrokTagrahaRam । ayamaBiprAyaH । aTa someneti trizvaDyAyezu jyotizwomAKyaH somayAgo'DikftaH, sa ca saMsyABedAnnAmaBedAccaturDA Binno vyutpAdito Bavati । tatra sarvatra somena yajetetyetadviDivihita evEko yAgaH kenacidupADivaSenAByasto Binno nAma pratIyate । ataH sarvezAM prakaraRitve prApte agnizwoma eva prakaraRI, anye tasyEva guRA vikArA iti jYApayitumukTya ityucyate । ukTya etAvadevOpadeSikaM, anyat sarvamAtideSikamityarTEtyevaM ASva॰ SrO॰ 6, 1, ka॰ tasya prakAro'mihitaH ukTena saMskAryye graharUpe 5 pAtraBede । “ukTyamupayAma gfhIta, iti” kAtyA॰ 9, 6, 21 । “ukTyAdi” kAtyA॰ 14, 2, 10 ukTyagrahaRAdi prAkftaM karmma Bavati ukTyasTAlyA ukTyasaMjYakaM grahaM gfhRAti” karkaH । prAgukTyAnmarutvatIyamftupAtreRa indramarutva iti” kAtyA॰ 10, 1, 14 । AgravaRagrahaRAnantaramukTyagrahaRAt prAgiti” karkaH ।

accompanied by Ukthas, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.

a: उक्थ्य — a. [उक्थमर्हति यत्] 1 Accompanied by praise. --2 Deserving praise or verses. --क्थ्यः 1 A libation at the morning and midday sacrifices. --2 N. of a sacrifice formng part of the ज्योतिष्टोम sacrifice. --3 A Soma sacrifice.

उक्तानुक्त mfn. spoken and not spoken.

m: उक्त mfn. (p.p. of √ वच्, q.v., उक्त, RV.), uttered, said, spoken
उक्त m. N. of a divine being (v.l. for उक्थ, q.v.), Hariv.
उक्त n. word, sentence, Śiś. &c.
उक्त nf. (अम्, आ) a stanza of four lines (with one syllabic instant or one long or two short syllables in each);
उक्त [cf. Zd. ukhta.]
a: उक्त — p. p. 1 Said, spoken. --2 Uttered, spoken (opp. to अनुमित or संभावित). --3 Told, addressed; असावनुक्तोऽपि सहाय एव Ku. 3. 21. --क्तं A speech, words collectively; a sentence. --क्तं --क्ता A stanza of four lines with one syllabic instant, (there being one long or two short syllables in each). --Comp. --अनुक्त a. spoken and not spoken. --उपसंहारः a brief description, rèsumé, peroration, recapitulation. --निर्वाहः defending an assertion. --पुंस्कः a word (feminine or neuter) of which also a masculine exists, and the meaning of which differs from that of the masculine only by the notion of gender. --प्रत्युक्तं speech and reply, discourse. --वाक्यं a dictum, decree.

k.v: त्यक्तं हीनं विधुतं समुज्झितं धूतमुत्सृष्टे। उक्तं भाषितमुदितं जल्पितमाख्यातमभिहितं लपितम्.।

m: उक्त—भाव mfn. having the sense already expressed, Hāla, Sch.
उक्त-मात्र mfn. merely uttered, MBh.

उक्त—पूर्व mfn. spoken before or formerly, MBh.
उक्त—प्रत्युक्त n. speech and reply, discourse, conversation, ŚBr. xi, 5, 1, 10
a kind of anthem or alternate song, Sāh.

उक्त—पुंस्क a (feminine or neuter) word of which also a masculine is mentioned or exists (and whose meaning only differs from that of the masculine by the notion of gender; e.g. the word गङ्गा is not उक्त-पुंस्क, whereas such words as शुभ्र and ग्राम-णी are so; cf. भाषित-पुंस्क), Vop. iv, 8.
उक्त—र्षि (for -ऋषि), m. the Ṛṣi mentioned, Anukr.
उक्त—त्व n. the being spoken or uttered, Sāh.
उक्त—वाक्य mfn. one who has given an opinion, R.
उक्त—वाक्य n. a dictum, decree, L.
उक्त—वर्जम् ind. except the cases mentioned.
उक्त—वत् mfn. one who has spoken (see √ वच्).

1. उक्ष् cl. 1. P. Ā. उक्षति, उक्षते (p. उक्षत्, RV. i, 114, 7, and उक्षमाण, AV. iii, 12, 1; RV. iv, 42, 4 &c.; उक्षां-चकार [Bhaṭṭ.; for ववक्ष &c. See √ वक्ष्]; औक्षत् and औक्षीत्, उक्षितुम्) to sprinkle, moisten, wet, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.; to sprinkle or scatter in small drops; to emit; to throw out, scatter (as sparks), RV.; AV. &c.; to emit seed (as a bull); to be strong, RV. i, 114, 7; x, 55, 7, &c. : Caus. Ā. उक्षयते, to strengthen, RV. vi, 17, 4;
उक्ष् [cf. Lith. ūkana: Hib. uisg, uisge, ‘water, a river’; uisgeach, ‘aquatic, watery, fluid, moist, pluvial:’ Gk. ὑγρός, ὑγρότης, ὑγραίνω: Lat. ūveo (for ugveo), ūmor, &c.]

becoming strong See साकम्-उक्ष्.

(उक्षति, उक्षांचकार, ववक्ष-क्षे Ved., औक्षीत्, उक्षितुं, उक्षित) 1 To sprinkle, wet, moisten, pour down upon; औक्षन् शोणितमंभोदाः Bk. 17. 9, 3. 5; Śi. 5. 30; R. 11. 5, 20; Ku. 1. 54. --2 To emit, send forth. --3 To scatter, throw out (as sparks). --4 To clean, purify. --5 To grow up, become strong (Ved.).
